name: David McAllister - § 76 - Am 53
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – 2024 annual report
part_text: 76. Calls on the Commission and the Member States to definitively abandon the signing the EU-Mercosur agreement, as it is detrimental to European farmers, undermines the agricultural and food sovereignty of the Union, and presents significant risks to public health and the environment ;
